$comment: Manifest of the required demo cases from PROOFLINE_BUILD_PLAN.md section 10. Expected POLICY outcomes are deliberately null: each requires a verified policy clause, and filling them in without the authoritative document would be inventing policy. Structural expectations are filled in. See data/README.md.

fixtures.description: Clean, machine-printed receipt with all critical fields legible.
Faded or rotated receipt where exactly one critical field is unreliable; must route to the employee correction path rather than guess.
Receipt is clean but a business-context field the policy requires for this category is absent.

expected.policy_dependency: which categories require client name or attendee count is a policy question that has not been answered

fixtures.description: Line items, tax and discount do not reconcile to the printed total, and the receipt itself supports the comparison.

expected.policy_dependency: the tolerance for rounding differences is a policy question

fixtures.description: Several individually acceptable claims in one period together exceed a real cumulative limit.

expected.note: Only valid if the approved policy contains a cumulative rule. If it does not, this case must be replaced rather than invented.

fixtures.description: The same transaction arrives through two channels, with the second image cropped or recompressed.

expected.reviewer_action: confirm or dismiss, with a reason

fixtures.description: Two genuinely different transactions with the same amount and the same date.

expected.note: Field agreement alone must never confirm a duplicate. This case exists to catch a detector that escalates on amount and date.

fixtures.description: A claim that would breach the assigned policy but is covered by an explicit, authorized, time-bounded exception.

requires: policy_exceptions row with reason, approver and effective range

fixtures.description: A rule cannot reach a conclusion because required evidence or context is absent.

expected.routing: review or correction, never a silent pass

fixtures.description: A correction to a claim causes dependent findings to be re-evaluated while preserving the earlier ones.
